text: The Corporations Nominating Panel must select candidates to interview for appointment to the CreateTO Board. Following the interviews, the Corporations Nominating Panel will recommend one candidate for appointment to City Council.

The Corporations Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the CreateTO Board: TRB2-60 TRB2-98 TRB2-109 TRB2-164 TRB2-224 TRB2-228 TRB2-255 TRB2-267 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (January 29, 2021) remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the CreateTO Board.
